## Scientific/formal voice

An Exceptional Access Grant is a short-lived, object- and operation-specific application grant for a documented rights, evidence or incident case, with separate owner approvals, expiry, purpose and use receipts.

### Notation

No notation is required.

### Boundary conditions

- It cannot authorize employer sharing, bulk export or a new processing purpose.
- An incident label alone does not create this grant or override normal access checks.
